help.title: Help
help.a1: A short exercise built from a task in your own week. You catch a mistake AI made, hand a task to AI and check what comes back, or practise a conversation AI can't have for you.
help.a2: Reps, the daily AI or me round and your streak all earn points. Spend them in the shop on discounts and months of Pro.
help.q3: How do I open my account on another device?
help.a3: Log in with your email and password on the other device. If you haven't made an account yet, choose Save my progress first: your week map and points move with you.
help.q4: How do I cancel my plan?
help.a4: Open Subscription and choose Manage subscription. Stripe's page lets you cancel or change your card.
help.q5: Where do the numbers come from?
help.a5: Every number in your week map comes from public data and research. How we measure lists each source and each step.
